title: kbwho --otel-attributes keeps an email in OTEL_SERVICE_NAME and in an OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES key
goal: kbwho.otel_attributes() drops an email-shaped service.name (falling back to kbmon) and an attribute whose key holds an email, as it drops one whose value does

run:
import os, subprocess, sys
em = "jan" + chr(64) + "corp-mail.test"
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/kbwho.py", "--otel-attributes"], env=dict(os.environ, OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=em, OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=em.replace(chr(64), "%40") + "=1"), capture_output=True, text=True)
leak = r.returncode != 0 or em in r.stdout or "%40" in r.stdout
print("kbwho failed or an email reaches the resource" if leak else "ok"); sys.exit(1 if leak else 0)
